title: Axioma Kinetic Façade Studio: Byzantine Fault-Tolerant Louver Mesh & Aerodynamic Shear Mitigator
narrative: Contemporary high-rise kinetic building envelopes deploy motorized louvers for solar heat-gain management and daylight harvesting. During severe atmospheric microbursts and wind-shear gradients, localized airflow exceeds 25.0 m/s, inducing severe aerodynamic lift and mounting shear. Centralized building management systems (BMS) frequently partition, crash, or suffer power surges during severe storms, stranding louvers at high attack angles (acting as sails) and causing mounting bracket tearing and envelope detachment. Axioma Kinetic Façade Studio establishes an autonomous 3x3 P2P IoT mesh where motorized louvers reach Byzantine consensus over 12 bidirectional gossip links to lock flat rigid (0 deg) when supermajorities (>= 2/3) of physical neighbors confirm wind shear, and execute an Orderly Calibrated Unwind Recovery Pipeline upon sustained calm.

actors.name: The Wind Vector (Adversary)
motivations: Generate localized velocity gradients and severe microbursts exceeding 25.0 m/s
Exploit high louver attack angles to induce destructive aerodynamic lift and torque (> 450 N*m)
Create localized asymmetric pressure fields across high-rise building envelopes
frustrations: Louvers transitioning to flat rigid (0 deg) orientation shedding aerodynamic drag by 88%
Decentralized sensor quorum detecting localized microbursts even when central BMS is offline

actors.name: The Mesh Node (Autonomous Edge Agent)
motivations: Maximize solar daylighting and thermal efficiency during calm conditions (0 to 90 deg tracking)
Preserve mechanical and structural mounting integrity under high wind-shear conditions
Reach rapid P2P Byzantine consensus (< 250ms) with physical spatial neighbors without central authority
frustrations: Centralized controller partitions leaving actuators stranded at sail angles during sudden storms
Faulty or iced anemometer probes injecting misleading or Byzantine sensor noise
Physical gear and actuator backlash when abrupt software rollback commands violate mechanical inertia

actors.name: Facade Structural Engineer & Facility Director
motivations: Eliminate structural envelope failures and zero facade panel detachments during category 3+ storms
Verify autonomous compliance with ISO/ASTM wind-load building codes and fail-closed safety standards
Inspect live mesh status and pBFT consensus audit trails on a lightweight diagnostic dashboard
frustrations: Opaque proprietary BMS black-boxes with unverified failure modes during network partitions
Unbudgeted, heavyweight 3D physics simulations that cannot run on edge field tablets
False-alarm lockouts that permanently freeze facade shading due to single faulty sensors

frictions.description: Centralized BMS single-point-of-failure strands louvers at sail attack angles during microbursts
frictions.impact: Catastrophic mechanical torque exceeding 450 N*m, shearing mounting brackets and tearing envelope panels
trigger_conditions: Severe storm lightning strike or network drop severs centralized BMS connectivity

frictions.description: Byzantine and sensor faults: iced or drifting anemometers report false calm or spurious storms
frictions.impact: Individual nodes either lock out unnecessarily (reducing daylight) or stay open during dangerous shear
trigger_conditions: Probe icing, electrical noise, or sensor degradation on local node

frictions.description: Actuator mechanical hysteresis: in-memory undo functor violates physical mechanics and gearbox causality
frictions.impact: Sudden reverse torque trips motor drives or strips gearbox teeth under high aerodynamic loading
trigger_conditions: Naïve software rollback command issued without ramped unwind calibration

frictions.description: Daylighting optimization vs. aerodynamic safety trade-off
frictions.impact: Premature recovery causes oscillation between open sail and emergency lock under gusty conditions
trigger_conditions: Transient lulls in storm eye followed by secondary microbursts

constraints.description: Maximum allowable aerodynamic blade torque before structural mounting failure is 450 N*m (reached at > 25.0 m/s when angle > 30 deg); flat rigid lock (0 deg) reduces drag coefficient Cd by 88%
Actuator dynamic slew rate bounded to max 15.0 deg/s with mandatory ramped deceleration to prevent gearbox shearing
Byzantine fault tolerance requires >= 2/3 supermajority consensus of physical neighbors before entering locked flat rigid state
[L1-G3B-012] Topological Fidelity: 9 nodes on routable cluster subnet (10.99.10.x:8101), interconnected by 12 bidirectional P2P gossip channels, rejecting single-machine loopback shortcuts

unmet_needs: Autonomous decentralized Byzantine quorum consensus on atmospheric shear without reliance on central BMS backhaul
Robust Byzantine tolerance against faulty or deceptive sensor nodes within local cliques
Physically causal Orderly Calibrated Unwind Recovery Pipeline from locked_flat_rigid back to phototropic tracking
Lightweight 2D SVG diagnostic telemetry dashboard visualizing lattice topology, live blade angles, gossip pulses, and pBFT consensus logs
